slot_note: seed AD03 re-rooted under the two-layer standard: no calibration corpus, no licensed wrong basis, the referral procedure filed in full
niche: an electricity supplier's revenue-protection team in the north of Scotland choosing which of eight field patches its one theft-investigation team works for the January to March quarter, where storage-heated homes carry a second, heating-only supply number on its own meter
stakeholder_role: revenue protection manager at an electricity supplier, who places the field investigation team for the quarter

spine.entity: one cumulative import register reading of one supply number on one day

world.geography: United Kingdom, north of Scotland (Highland and Moray)
world.org_type: domestic electricity supplier with a revenue protection function

driver: The referral test is filed for each metered sub-unit against its own history, but the ready-made series sums the sub-units of an entity, and where an entity holds a second sub-unit carrying one seasonal load, a large fall on that sub-unit moves the entity total by a few per cent, inside ordinary variation, so screening the summed series ranks the candidates differently from screening each sub-unit and counting entities once.
driver_concrete: Corran's procedure refers a supply number whose weather-adjusted consumption over the latest eight weeks sits 30 per cent or more under its own two-year history, and storage-heated homes in Caithness carry a second, heating-only supply number; a bypass on the heating meter takes 36 to 58 per cent off that supply while the account's weekly total in the analytics mart falls by 6.5 to 23.9 per cent, so the procedure run on the mart's account totals names Elgin, and run on each supply's daily register reads, counting each premises once, names Caithness.
stump: A competent solver runs the filed referral test (weather-adjusted, own two-year history, 30 per cent over eight weeks, voids and heating changes excluded) on the analytics mart's weekly account consumption and places the team in Elgin; the step that lands it there is treating an account's weekly total as the supply the procedure screens, when storage-heated premises in Caithness hold a second, heating-only supply whose bypassed meter shows a 36 to 58 per cent shortfall that moves the account total by 6.5 to 23.9 per cent, under the 30 per cent band.

differentiation.task72: task72 books a correctly measured movement to the owner whose agreement covered each piece of service across a transfer; here nothing is attributed between owners: an anomaly test has to run on each metered component because a summed series dilutes a one-component fall below the referral band.
differentiation.task103: task103 counts units a contact served through standing authorizations; here no unit is fanned out or recovered from a quantity: the test is applied per metered supply and counted once per premises, and the trap is dilution of a component fall in a summed series.
differentiation.task81: task81 recovers a paid entity across registry renumbering by matching sub-unit sets; here identities are stable and known, and the move is the grain at which a filed anomaly test is run, not who the entity is.
differentiation.task86: task86 runs an earlier draw on a shared pool forward member by member; here there is no pool or draw, the difficulty is a summed series hiding a component-level anomaly from a filed screen.
differentiation.task90: task90 chains supplier asset stays into a buyer-side position for a tariff; here no chaining or re-rating: the summed account series is correct and simply too coarse for a per-supply anomaly test.

notes: Subdomain 'other': revenue protection (energy theft detection) at a supplier, an anomaly-detection task type the energy taxonomy does not list. Bespoke draw from how north-of-Scotland storage heating is metered (a related, heating-only supply number).
